body: Long-horizon mobile manipulation presents significant challenges due to compounding execution errors and capacity interference between locomotion and arm control. While recent Vision-Language-Action models excel at short-horizon tasks, they lack the hierarchical reasoning required for multi-stage objectives. Furthermore, existing hierarchical agents suffer from rigid sub-task mapping, inflexible replanning, and a lack of continuous learning. To address these limitations, we introduce MobiAgent, a dual-loop agentic framework that bridges robust deployment execution and recursive policy self-improvement. During deployment, the Inner Loop decouples high-level reasoning from low-level control through highly composable atomic skills. It employs Vision-Language models for receding-horizon planning and visual reflection, dynamically composing skills to ensure robust error recovery. These skills are executed by specialized flow-matching experts that share a unified VLM backbone, maximizing reusability while mitigating capacity interference. Concurrently, the Outer Loop drives automated lifelong learning by autonomously segmenting and verifying deployment rollouts, clustering them to discover atomic skills, and continuously fine-tuning the skill library without human annotations. Evaluations on RoboCasa, BEHAVIOR-1K, and real-world tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of MobiAgent. It outperforms π0.5-TA by 22.5 percentage points on BEHAVIOR-1K and enables robust recovery from execution failures. Through autonomous data recycling, success improves from 7.50% to 27.50% on RoboCasa and from 32.5% to 57.5% on Astribot S1.
summaryZh: MobiAgent 是一种针对长周期移动操作任务设计的双循环智能体框架。其内循环通过视觉语言模型（VLM）实现高层推理与底层控制的解耦，利用流匹配专家执行原子技能，确保任务执行的鲁棒性。外循环则通过自主数据回收与技能聚类，实现无需人工标注的终身学习。在 RoboCasa 和 BEHAVIOR-1K 等基准测试中，MobiAgent 表现出卓越的性能，成功率大幅提升，并能有效应对执行失败后的自动恢复，为复杂环境下的机器人自主操作提供了新的技术路径。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该研究提出的双循环框架有效解决了长周期移动操作中的任务规划与执行难题，显著提升了机器人自主学习与错误恢复能力。

glossary.explanationZh: 移动操作，指机器人结合移动底盘与机械臂进行复杂任务处理的能力。
视觉-语言-动作模型，将视觉感知、语言理解与动作控制整合的端到端模型。
流匹配，一种用于生成式建模的概率路径方法，常用于机器人动作生成。
后退视界规划，一种动态规划策略，通过不断更新未来路径以适应环境变化。
终身学习，指模型在部署过程中持续从新数据中学习而不遗忘旧知识的能力。
